provenance: Manual transcription of observed physical process, HTTP, profiler, and filesystem outputs; not an independently signed log or latency distribution.

hardware.exclusive_ownership: One supervised server at a time; each server exited cleanly with mesh closed. Ports 8190 and 8189 had no listeners after the final run.

method.clock: time.perf_counter from process bootstrap before Python package imports through actual emitted stage:ready marker; same bootstrap on both packages
method.environment: Same Python 3.13 and TTNN 0.77, variant-specific physical MESH_DEVICE and existing revision-named checkpoint/tensor caches. Unset inherited TT_MESH_GRAPH_DESC_PATH and TT_METAL_SIMULATOR as production wrappers do; HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1. Python bootstrap mirrors wrapper environment but is not the wrapper executable.
method.private_cache_setup: New owner-private directory (mode 0700) on /datapool; 522 GiB free before probe; both arms set identical supported TT_METAL_CACHE override. The dedicated cache grew to 2.4 GiB after exercised requests. First-use kernel compilation occurred after stage:ready; later requests exercised warmed shapes.
method.sample_size: Each unprofiled process-start pair has one baseline and one rebuilt process, not a statistically powered latency series. Requests are serial and repeated within each process.

clef_flash_9b_default_home_kernel_cache.note: Rebuilt long HTTP request later failed from HOME cache ENOSPC; this arm is not full-shape verification.

clef_flash_9b_private_kernel_cache.note: Flash does not use changed TP shard helper; no Flash speedup established.

source_and_profiler.interpretation: Child phases overlap their parents and Python profiling changes timings. After avoiding full CPU weight transpose/copy on hits, remaining measured startup is primarily language-layer assembly and cached TTNN device loads; KV allocation remains on first HTTP, not before readiness.
source_and_profiler.cache_compatibility: TTNN 0.77 as_tensor appends _dtype_<dtype.name>_layout_TILE.tensorbin and loads the existing flatbuffer via load_tensor_flatbuffer(device=mesh); ttnn.load_tensor uses that same low-level load. The new TP-only fast path checks precisely this file; absent file or RuntimeError falls through to unchanged torch BF16 transpose and as_tensor cache creation/repair. Cache directories already distinguish checkpoint revision and TP mesh shape.

default_home_environment_failure.observed: One rebuilt Flash long request returned HTTP 500: TTNN 0.77 could not write a cached XIP ELF, reporting No space left on device at $HOME/.cache/tt-metal-cache; root filesystem then had zero bytes available.
default_home_environment_failure.mitigation_for_verification_only: Both baseline and rebuilt variants repeated with identical TT_METAL_CACHE private override on spacious /datapool; long/image/video and warmed repeats passed. No deletion or modification of user HOME cache, system files, or Nix GC was performed.

limits: No cold tensor-cache rebuild, cache corruption injection, corpus-wide numerical equivalence, throughput, or repeat-sampled startup distribution was measured.
The temporary process bootstrap includes instrument-only ready timing but performs no model requests before ready; source patch modifies only TP shard-weight cache hits.
